The exact calculation used in the "CalculatePetunias" task to determine the number of petunias is:

\[ \text{Number of Petunias} = \text{Number of Geraniums} - 40 \]

Given that Andy plants 90 geraniums, the calculation becomes:

\[ \text{Number of Petunias} = 90 - 40 = 50 \]

The exact numerical value of petunias calculated in the "CalculatePetunias" task is 50. This value relates to the 90 geraniums as follows: Andy plants 40 fewer petunias than geraniums. Therefore, if he plants 90 geraniums, the number of petunias planted would be \(90 - 40 = 50\).
